title: TDP-43 Coincides with Noradrenergic Neurons in Alzheimer's Disease (AD) and Primary Age-Related Tauopathy (PART).
authors: Uruk, Gokhan; Youssef, Hossam; Gatto, Rodolfo G; Hossain, Nadia; Bhaskaran, Jerusha; Tian, Yuqi; Machulda, Mary M; Petersen, Ronald C; Whitwell, Jennifer L; Reichard, Robert Ross; Josephs, Keith A
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用AI对象检测和多重免疫荧光分析TDP-43在AD/PART中的神经元共定位，虽涉及蛋白-DNA结合蛋白但未聚焦TF-DNA互作或结合建模，方法为图像分析而非AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) pathology is a major contributor to cognitive decline in Alzheimer's disease (AD), yet the cellular substrates and circuit-level consequences of its limbic accumulation remain poorly defined. Here, we combined multiplex immunofluorescence with 3D Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based object detection and quantitative colocalization to map phosphorylated TDP-43 (pTDP-43) across neuronal subtypes in the amygdala, hippocampal subfields, and entorhinal cortex (ERC) in human AD, AD with Lewy body disease (AD-LBD), and primary age-related tauopathy (PART). Across 15 deeply phenotyped cases, pTDP-43 showed preferential accumulation in neuromodulatory noradrenergic neurons, with more limited involvement of glutamatergic terminals and cholinergic populations. Noradrenergic neurons marked by dopamine beta-hydroxylase (DbetaH) demonstrated extensive colocalization with pTDP-43 across regions, correlating with APOE genotype, amyloid burden, and tau staging in this cross-sectional cohort, suggesting that neuromodulatory circuits might represent a major convergence point for AD-related molecular stressors. Dopaminergic (tyrosine hydroxylase (TH)) and cholinergic (choline acetyltransferase (ChAT)) neurons showed more restricted but pathology-dependent involvement, with LBD consistently showing lower pTDP-43 burden across multiple transmitter systems. Glutamatergic vesicular glutamate transporter-1 (VGLUT1)-positive neurons and terminals exhibited minimal colocalization except in PART. Principal component (PCA) and hierarchical clustering analyses (HCA) integrating pTDP-43 colocalization with neuropathologic staging metrics (A, B, C, Thal, Braak, LBD) reliably separated PART, AD-TDP, and AD-TDP-LBD groups, with LBD emerging as a dominant modifier of cellular vulnerability. Together, these findings point out that TDP-43 pathology in AD preferentially targets neuromodulatory circuits, is strongly shaped by coexisting synucleinopathy, and provides a cell-type-resolved framework for understanding how TDP-43 contributes to limbic network dysfunction in neurodegeneration.
abstract_zh: TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）病理是阿尔茨海默病（AD）认知衰退的主要贡献因素，然而其边缘系统积累的细胞底物及回路水平后果仍不明确。本研究结合多重免疫荧光与基于三维人工智能（AI）的物体检测及定量共定位分析，在人类AD、AD伴路易体病（AD-LBD）及原发性年龄相关tau病（PART）中，绘制了杏仁核、海马亚区及内嗅皮层（ERC）内神经元亚型中磷酸化TDP-43（pTDP-43）的分布图谱。在15例深度表型分型的病例中，pTDP-43优先积累于神经调节性去甲肾上腺素能神经元，而谷氨酸能末梢和胆碱能群体的受累程度较为有限。以多巴胺β-羟化酶（DbetaH）标记的去甲肾上腺素能神经元在各区域中与pTDP-43表现出广泛共定位，并与该横断面队列中的APOE基因型、淀粉样蛋白负荷及tau分期相关，提示神经调节回路可能代表AD相关分子应激的主要汇聚点。多巴胺能（酪氨酸羟化酶（TH））和胆碱能（胆碱乙酰转移酶（ChAT））神经元表现出更受限但依赖病理的受累，且LBD在多个递质系统中一致显示较低的pTDP-43负荷。谷氨酸能囊泡谷氨酸转运体-1（VGLUT1）阳性神经元及末梢仅在PART中表现出最小共定位。整合pTDP-43共定位与神经病理分期指标（A、B、C、Thal、Braak、LBD）的主成分分析（PCA）和层次聚类分析（HCA）可靠地区分了PART、AD-TDP和AD-TDP-LBD组，其中LBD作为细胞易感性的主导调节因子出现。综合来看，这些发现表明AD中的TDP-43病理优先靶向神经调节回路，受共存的突触核蛋白病强烈影响，并为理解TDP-43在神经退行性变中如何促成边缘网络功能障碍提供了细胞类型分辨的框架。
